question: What does the current Session Manager actually decouple, and what do feature extraction, loop handoff, admit, mixed encoder/decode steps and realtime mean in the current code?

configuration_profile.runtime: Installed vLLM 0.23.0 and Transformers 4.57.6; Qwen2.5-Omni snapshot selected by the retained GPU diagnostic manifest
configuration_profile.inspection: Current first-party sources and installed dependency sources; retained-run timestamps; CPU-only processor shape probe with two seconds of zero-valued 16 kHz audio. No new inference run or results directory.

change: Audit only; document remaining EngineCore input-plan coupling and exact existing trace endpoint semantics. No runtime or exporter behavior changed.

code_confirmed: Managed input awaits session_plan utility completion before queue.put; EngineCore processes utility messages between synchronous model iterations.
Manager timer and CopyService submission/completion progress independently, but active/idle notifications and native D2H/demand-H2D descriptor generation still originate in scheduler lifecycle.
IS/IE surround all InputProcessor.process_inputs, IE/IR measure thread-to-loop resumption, and IR/IA ends after asynchronous request sending rather than scheduler acceptance.
The current GPUModelRunner executes multimodal encoding in _preprocess before the shared language-model forward; per-session schedule slices replicate the batch observation interval.

The custom Go gateway plus gRPC worker uses AsyncLLM.generate with StreamingInput; it does not invoke the installed OpenAIServingRealtime endpoint. Qwen2_5OmniThinkerForConditionalGeneration does not implement SupportsRealtime.

processor_shape_probe.measurement_kind: Direct CPU shape observation, not a latency benchmark
processor_shape_probe.mechanism: HF Qwen processor forces max_length padding; WhisperFeatureExtractor pads to n_samples before STFT and mel computation; the vLLM model processor applies the validity mask after feature computation.

retained_pipeline_ms.measurement_kind: Measured wall-clock station differences from per_request.log, first normal P and later, complete station tuples, excluding warmup sentinel and preloading; 1 ms source timestamp resolution
retained_pipeline_ms.percentile_method: median; p95 at sorted index round((n-1)*0.95); includes zero-duration pairs

mixed_batch_example.measurement_kind: Retained derived Perfetto clock; scheduler observation interval, not isolated GPU encoder duration

remaining_uncertainty: No nested processor timing or CPU sampling profile: padding is verified extra work but its fraction of observed input processing latency is not measured; no speedup claim.
No isolated encoder timing for the 80 ms mixed batch; GPU kernel ownership is at the batch/request-set level.
Plan-utility wait lacks its own request-correlated start/end events; P-to-F also contains worker scheduling and queueing.
No new validation of full model-history equivalence, deadline-aware scheduling or automatic compute/transfer budget planning.
